subject.title: Proposal: Publish a provider compatibility matrix with deprecation policy

question: Should OpenClaw commit to a public provider lifecycle matrix with stable/experimental/deprecated/broken statuses and deprecation windows across official, bundled, and community providers?
rationale: The implementation would define support guarantees, metadata ownership, and public lifecycle semantics rather than simply filling in a missing docs table.

options.title: Approve Scoped Lifecycle Registry
options.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with owner, capability, status, deadline, replacement, and canonical issue fields, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.

options.title: Publish Docs-Only Policy First
options.body: Document provider support guarantees and deprecation windows before committing to a machine-readable registry or CLI output contract.

options.title: Defer Broad Guarantees
options.body: Keep provider status limited to live probes and catalog metadata, and handle provider breakages through specific regression issues.

recommendation.title: Approve Scoped Lifecycle Registry
recommendation.body: Create a provider lifecycle registry with owner, capability, status, deadline, replacement, and canonical issue fields, then generate docs and doctor/models summaries from it.
